_comment: Articles with the green Quick Answer go straight from the table of contents to their first heading (npm run verify, 'Article openings'). exceptions: per page, the intentional notice elements allowed before the first heading, each named by its opening words with the reason (any other text there still counts), or noHeadings for an article whose body has no headings at all. pendingReview: pages where an ordinary opening paragraph remains (after any excepted notice), waiting for Randy's decision; reported as warnings until corrected, then removed from this list.
